description: The Tupolev Tu-4P is a propeller-driven night fighter. It was converted from the Tu-4 bomber by moving the ventral navigation radar to a radome in place of the forward dorsal turret, which gave the aircraft a basic 360-degree air-search radar, and by equipping the bomb bay as an air-intercept control post. The NATO reporting name is Bull.
variantnotes: Articulated Guns. The guns can fire in any direction. They may return fire twice per game turn in response to gun attacks or conduct one attack. Hit rolls are modified only by the target size and a -1 modifier when firing into the 60- arc. The guns have basic infrared sights and, as an exception to the normal rules, may attack detected but unsighted aircraft at night with an additional modifier of -2.
loadnotes: No stores may be carried. The internal bomb bay is used to house the air-intercept control post.
